title: A Monolithic Stairway- Machu Picchu.jpg
author: Hiram Bingham III
description: In some cases the smaller stairways are cut partly or entirely out of a single granite boulder. The stairway in this picture leads from the beautifully made houses of what has been termed the Princess Group, by reason of the exquisiteness of the stone work, down to the more roughly made houses probably once occupied by the retainers and the less important members of the family which occupied this
